data.long_meaning: The name Gretal is derived from the Old English word 'gretel,' meaning 'traveler.' The addition of the prefix 'gre' may indicate 'grace,' giving the name the meaning 'Graceful Traveler.'. The name Gretal carries the meaning “Graceful Traveler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gretal usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
